name: Stat
summary: A big bold number with a small uppercase tracked unit and optional delta + sparkline. Warp signature primitive. v0.10 — Satoshi-only; tabular alignment via OpenType tnum, not a separate mono face. v0.11.17 — sparkline is fluid (preferred max width, scales to fit tight columns) and right-anchored via ml-auto; StatGrid `divided` divider is a gap-centred pseudo-element so all columns share equal content area.

value.description: The number. Always render with tabular numerics (Satoshi tnum + lnum) so stacked KPIs align column-true.

unit.description: Small uppercase tracked unit suffix ('%', 'lb', 'days'). v0.10 — Satoshi at .text-data-* with calt off + tnum on.

polarity.description: Which direction is 'good' for this metric — drives both delta-pill tone and sparkline tone. v0.11.12.

sparkData.description: number[] — numeric series for the auto-rendered Sparkline. Tone is derived from polarity+trend. Endpoint pulse on by default. v0.11.12. (Schema 'node' type used for array props per Lumen convention; runtime type is number[].)

pulse.description: Override the default endpoint pulse on the auto-built Sparkline. Defaults to true when sparkData is provided. v0.11.12.

rules: Trend arrow uses aria-hidden; meaning lives in the delta string.
Real-time Stats are wrapped in aria-live='polite' by the consumer.

do: Always tabular numerics for the value (Satoshi tnum + lnum + zero).
Pair with unit in text-tertiary so the number reads as hero.
Use StatGrid for rows of Stats to enforce uniform sizing.
Use sparkData for live KPIs — the Stat owns the Sparkline and derives tone from polarity+trend.
Trust the fluid Sparkline (v0.11.17) — pass width=88 (the default) and the SVG fits whatever column it lands in.
dont: Don't put delta inside value — separate line.
Don't mix sizes within a row.
Don't manually wrap the Sparkline with shrink-0 to lock its width — the v0.11.17 fluid layout is the contract; locking it re-introduces the column-overflow bug it was built to fix.

changelog.note: Token consumption swapped from font.family.mono to font.family.sans — v0.10 single-typeface system. Tabular alignment now carried by OpenType tnum/lnum/zero on Satoshi.

v0.11.17 — Sparkline becomes width-fluid (viewBox + preserveAspectRatio='xMaxYMid meet' + non-scaling-stroke), so the SVG scales down anchored right when the parent is too narrow for the preferred width. Stat spark wrapper drops shrink-0 for min-w-0 so it can shrink with its column. StatGrid `divided` divider re-implemented as a gap-centred ::before pseudo-element so cols 1..N share an identical content area; the fluid spark renders at the same width across every column. Closes the SaaS LanePerf SEA → DEN sparkline-overflow bug. See ADR 0019.
